test_join_on_index: test DataFrame.join() to merge two DataFrames on their index with configurable join type
test_join_on_column: test DataFrame.join() with on parameter to merge on a column value instead of index
test_merge_join_types: test merge() with left, right, inner, and outer join types on shared key columns
test_join_multiindex: test DataFrame.join() with MultiIndex on one or both DataFrames for hierarchical key matching
test_join_cross: test DataFrame.join() with how='cross' to produce a Cartesian product of two DataFrames
test_join_categorical_index: test DataFrame.join() with CategoricalIndex preserving category order and dtype
test_join_many_dataframes: test joining a list of multiple DataFrames on index with different join types
test_join_datetime_tz: test DataFrame.join() on timezone-aware datetime columns matching overlapping date ranges
test_join_suffix_overlap: test merge() with custom suffixes to handle overlapping column names from both DataFrames
test_join_error_handling: test that merge() raises MergeError or ValueError for incompatible types, mismatched key counts, or duplicate column suffixes
